formula.E1: cells x (e1_ordering_seconds + checkpoints_per_cell x e1_k16_seconds + k48_confirms_per_cell x e1_k48_seconds) + calibrations x e1_calibration_seconds
formula.E2: Q6: seeds x (e2_train_m2_high + e2_train_full_high + adapters x e2_a2_pass_high), the full 2 adapters x S retrain set; Phase 40 reusing existing seed adapters is savings, not a cut
formula.E3: recipes x sigmas x (e3_overhead_high + max_steps x e3_per_step_high + e3_score_high); the reused v4.0 sigma = 0 cell is not discounted (a high bound)
formula.E4: points x e4_point_seconds (D-06: up to e4_reserve_points; never reallocated)
formula.E5: e5_clearance_setup + sets x e5_slot_clearance_high + sets x max_set_size x e5_match_high + prefixes x (adapter_setup_high + sets x max_set_size x e5_nll_high)
formula.E6: adapters x (adapter_setup_high + a2_regenerated_entries x a2_question_k48_high x max_k / FULL_FIDELITY_K + (entries + anchor_slots) x e5_candidates_per_slot_max x e5_nll_high) + anchor_adapters x anchor_slots x max_k x e6_anchor_draw_high. The A2-context generation is priced at a2_regenerated_entries x max_k (default a2_regenerated_entries = entries, in full); a cap ruling of 0 reuses the committed K = 48 A2 records instead, verified by SHA-256, and Phase 39 pauses for Rafael rather than regenerate
formula.R1b: D-04: one erased-arm reading = a2_k48_high (the measured k = 78 reading under every ruling). Other Phase 19 arms (retrain 46.6 min, replicate 45.3 min) and the M1 re-sweep (6.959 min) are NOT in R1b's hours: if Phase 37 wants them they need Rafael's approved (D-06: nothing reallocated)
formula.a2_k16_high: H1: max over the two E1 runs of k16_seconds (fixed + first CURVE_K draws)
formula.a2_k48_high: H1: max over the two E1 runs of total_seconds (k = 78, K = 48)
formula.a2_question_k48_high: H1: max over the E1 runs of mean(per_question_k48_seconds)
formula.adapter_setup_high: max of the E5 scoring adapter setups and the E6 setup
formula.e1_calibration_seconds: e2_train_m2_high + 60 x results/phase19_calibration_curve.json wall_clock_min + 60 x results/phase19_arm_cal-erased.json config.wall_clock_min, NOT re-measured (records); probe_scaled multiplies the two record terms by a2_k48_high / (60 x the erased arm's wall_clock_min)
formula.e1_k16_seconds: as e1_k48_seconds with k16 for K (a2_draw_basis)
formula.e1_k48_seconds: E1's per-checkpoint K = 48 price: a2_k48_high by default (a2_draw_basis k78); under the at_cap ruling max over runs of fixed + questions x K x the MAX at-cap draw seconds
formula.e1_ordering_seconds: Q5: 60 x results/phase19_collateral_curve.json wall_clock_min, read from the record and NOT re-measured
formula.e1_spread_ratio: max / min of the two E1 K = 48 run totals
formula.e2_a2_pass_high: H2 within_run: a2_pass fixed_seconds + (draws / draws_per_question) x max per-question block sum; spread_scaled: a2_pass total_seconds x e1_spread_ratio
formula.e2_train_full_high: the full taught adapter, derived from the M2 probe: max rep loop_seconds (MAX_STEPS steps, independent of the fact count) + max rep overhead_seconds x n_facts_real / n_facts_m2
formula.e2_train_m2_high: H1: max over the two M2 reps of outer_seconds
formula.e3_overhead_high: H1: max over the two E3 runs of overhead_seconds
formula.e3_per_step_high: H1: max over the T = STEP_BUDGET and T = e3_max_steps runs of loop_seconds / steps; x max_batch / the probed batch when Rafael's cap ruling raises E3.max_batch (linear in batch, a high bound; E4 keeps the v4.0 batch)
formula.e3_score_high: H2 within_run on the T = STEP_BUDGET score_arm pass (score does not depend on T); spread_scaled: score_seconds x e1_spread_ratio
formula.e4_canary_seconds: D-19: results/phase26_canary_sources.json points.<E3 probe point>.provenance.scoring_seconds, used as the high bound and NOT re-measured
formula.e4_point_seconds: D-06/D-19: e3_overhead_high + STEP_BUDGET x e3_per_step_high (unscaled: E4 audits the v4.0 recipe) + e4_canary_seconds; carried in unit_prices for Phase 43's first-point check
formula.e5_prices: H3: clearance setup_seconds; max per_slot_seconds; match spread max; max over adapters and slots of per_slot_mean_candidate_seconds; max candidates_per_slot
formula.halt: D-15 / COST-02: total above mps_ceiling_hours -> HALT and the cut table in cut_order; no row is applied without Rafael's ruling; S below cut_table_min_seeds is never a row
formula.high_bound: D-10/D-02 via phase36_prereg high_bound_rule: H1 = max of the repetitions; H2 = a single draw-loop run priced from its own per-draw distribution (non-draw seconds + questions x the max per-question block of draw seconds); H3 = the max block mean
formula.hours: front_hours = seconds / 3600 per V6_MPS_FRONTS, unrounded; total = math.fsum
formula.probes: W2 / D-11 / D-12: phase36_ledger.spent(tracked, ledger_path=<the committed ledger blob>, fronts=('probes',))['by_front']['probes'] — the five records' provenance.run clocks PLUS every lost probe attempt, never the five records alone
formula.stop_line: D-13: min(stop_line_factor x total, mps_ceiling_hours), only when total fits

note: a RESOURCE record and pre-committed stop line, not an outcome threshold: no verdict reads it
